title: GTA 6's Massive Soundtrack Is Starting To Be Revealed
summary: Keith Richards of the Rolling Stones, Rauw Alejandro, Travis Scott, and others are teasing that their songs are included in Grand Theft Auto 6
text: GTA 6's Massive Soundtrack Is Starting To Be Revealed Skip to content Kotaku Latest Entertainment Reviews News Tips & Guides Games Downloads Deals News GTA 6 ‘s Massive Soundtrack Is Starting To Be Revealed Keith Richards of the Rolling Stones, Rauw Alejandro, Travis Scott, and others are teasing that their songs are included in Grand Theft Auto 6 Downgrade GTA 6 Rockstar Games Rolling Stones Travis Scott By Zack Zwiezen Published September 15, 2026 | Comments ( 31 ) | 𝕏 Copied! © Rockstar Games Multiple musicians and groups have started teasing their involvement in Rockstar’s upcoming open-world blockbuster, Grand Theft Auto 6. It’s another example of GTA 6 ‘s growing marketing push as we get closer and closer to the game’s launch in November. On September 15, music artists like Travis Scott and Morgan Wallen started posting new, never-before-seen GTA 6 artwork on sites like Instagram and Twitter. Some of these posts include a tease related to the upcoming game, which is expected to be one of the biggest game releases in decades. And it’s not just young guns posting about GTA 6, with longtime Rolling Stones member Keith Richards posting some new GTA 6 artwork of an iguana on his official Instagram account, likely confusing some of his older fans. View this post on Instagram Here’s the full list of artists who have seemingly teased their involvement with GTA 6 on social media: CARIEL & Paco Amoroso Raúw Alejandro Travis Scott Morgan Wallen Keith Richards Metro Boomin Yung Lean Future PINKPANTHERESS I expect these artists will all have songs included on GTA 6′ s radio stations. Thanks to all the leaks that happened last month, we know what many of these stations will be and already have a list of songs that are set to appear in the game. Interestingly, so far at least, none of the artists teasing their involvement in GTA 6 had songs included in the recent leaks . It makes me wonder just how big GTA 6′ s soundtrack is going to be when it arrives later this year. “NOW ITS TIME. MY RETURN TO GAME. GOTTA COME WITH RAGE AND A LOT OF DANCING. LET’S RIDE. J… O. H… ..to be continued. See y’all soon @rockstargames,” posted Travis Scott alongside the new GTA 6 artwork. And yes, of course, GTA fans have already catalogued all of the new GTA 6 artwork, including an image of an empty pool, a flamingo pool floaty, and the feet of a woman in heels. All six new artworks (seem to be all so far) pic.twitter.com/lOsy5rPHuv - ben (@videotech) September 15, 2026 Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to launch on November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
